products.name: CrystalWorkshop
products.summary: A modding editor for the FINAL FANTASY XIII trilogy on PC: sheets, text, models, effects, scenes, scripts and the Crystarium. It exports CrystalWorkshop Shards (.cws) that players install with PulseDepot.
features: **Sheets (WDB) and SQL**: edit typed database sheets, or query and change them with SQL. Changes show as a dry run before you apply them.
**Text (ZTR)**: every locale side by side, control tags with a tag palette, and add/rename/delete keys.
**Models**: inspect meshes, materials, textures, skeleton and motions, rendered with the game's own shaders. Round-trip through a glTF workspace (Blender) with a dry-run import.
**VFX**: package tree, typed inspector, field edits (XIII), safe model/texture reference swaps, and playback.
**Scenes (LYB)**: a 3D scene editor with fly camera, picking, move/rotate/scale gizmo, typed fields, and add/duplicate/delete of placements. XIII-2 and LR layouts are Experimental.
**Scripts, actions, events and sound**: decompile scripts to Java, edit, compile and merge (JDK 17+ needed).
**Export**: a portable .cws shard with metadata, changelog and image, or loose files for your own testing.
**AI (MCP)**: crystalw --mcp or the in-app server lets Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Codex use the same editors, with a read-only kill switch.

requirements: **CrystalWorkshop previews:** Bundled DXVK 3.1.1; a GPU and driver with Vulkan 1.3
**Script mods and script editing:** A JDK 17 or newer (not bundled), e.g. Eclipse Temurin
windows.label: Windows 10/11 x64

requirements: **CrystalWorkshop previews:** The system's DXVK-native (`libdxvk_d3d9.so`, e.g. Arch `libdxvk`) with SDL3 or SDL2; Vulkan 1.3
**Script mods and script editing:** A JDK 17 or newer from your distribution (not bundled)
linux.label: Linux x86_64

knownIssues: XIII-2/LR VFX fields are read-only, and their exports are unverified in game.
Model imports apply only simple changes (no new vertices, materials or bones).
Unsigned (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway); no installer; no AppImage.

products.name: PulseDepot

stores.name: Microsoft Store
stores.note: XIII-2 only; cannot start the game

products.summary: The mod manager for the FINAL FANTASY XIII trilogy on PC: install CrystalWorkshop shards and older Nova Chrysalia mod packages without touching your archives or your saves.
features: FF13 / XIII2 / LR tabs; each game has its own folder, list and launcher options. Steam games are detected automatically on Windows and Linux.
Add **.cws** shards and Nova Chrysalia **.ncmp**/.zip packages with Add mod… or drag and drop.
Enable, disable and order mods (later mods win). Conflicts are flagged, and text, database and WPD files are merged entry by entry.
**Review changes** shows exactly what will be installed, updated, downgraded or removed before anything is written. **Apply changes** installs the set.
Version-aware: updates replace a listed mod, downgrades ask first, and changelogs show what is new.
A clear warning for mods that ship native code.
Crux is installed and verified by SHA-256 for you: the NovaFix addon if NovaFix is present, otherwise the standalone build.
Saves are never read or written. Mod settings live in Crux's own per-slot storage.
Game launcher (Steam), Create package, and Format tools (WPD/WDB/ZTR/filelist/TRB/SCD/xlsx/SQLite conversions).

requirements: **PulseDepot:** Windows 10/11 x64; D3D12 or Vulkan
**The game:** Steam
**Script mods and script editing:** A JDK 17 or newer (not bundled), e.g. Eclipse Temurin
windows.label: Windows 10/11 x64

requirements: **PulseDepot:** x86_64; Vulkan or OpenGL
**The game:** Steam with Proton. The standalone Crux needs the launch option `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="version=n,b" %command%`
**Script mods and script editing:** A JDK 17 or newer from your distribution (not bundled)
linux.label: Linux x86_64

changelog.text: first public release. Crux in two builds with NovaFix detection, .cws shards, Nova Chrysalia package import, review/apply, changelogs and version prompts, Windows and Linux builds.

knownIssues: Not yet tested on real Windows or in game.
Unsigned (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway); no installer; no AppImage on Linux.
The list cannot be reordered by drag and drop; use the ▲/▼ buttons.

products.name: Crux
products.summary: The mod host the game loads. It serves the merged mod image to the game while it runs and loads the mods’ native code. It ships inside PulseDepot, which installs the right build for you.

builds.install: Crux.dll in the NovaFix addons folder (NovaFix loads addons\*.dll)
version.dll beside the game executable, without NovaFix; forwards every export to System32\version.dll

requirements: **Installed by PulseDepot** 0.1.0-beta: it checks each DLL's SHA-256 before installing it.
**The game:** Steam
